mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Spocket: which one is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business end to end: AI product research, competitor store analysis, product pages and going live on Shopify. Spocket is better if your goal is sourcing suppliers based in Europe and the United States to cut your delivery times. For launching and running a store, Copyfy wins; for local sourcing, Spocket stays solid.

Yes, at entry level: Spocket starts at 39€/month against 49€/month for Copyfy. But Spocket is limited to EU and US supplier sourcing, while Copyfy covers product research, competitor store analysis, AI listings and store generation. Add up the tools you need for the same result and the bill goes past 49€/month. The free trial runs 5 days, no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which has the better product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, for finding winning products. Its AI detects opportunities directly and analyzes competitor stores. Spocket offers a supplier catalog with advanced filters instead: it's useful for finding a reliable supplier, but it isn't winning-product detection.

Partly. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, pages and Shopify integration, which Spocket doesn't do. Spocket, on the other hand, stays a Europe/US supplier network: if your core business is sourcing with local stock, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, no credit card, plus a 5-day free trial. Spocket doesn't offer a free trial. The simplest move is to test Copyfy free to see whether the suite covers your need before paying for a sourcing subscription.
